processing: Regional subset clipped to coverage; coordinates rounded to five decimals. Lake ring winding preserves islands; artificial lake centerlines are omitted. Natural Earth 1:10 million generalization is retained, not enhanced. Michigan city, village and census-designated-place reference points use the 2025 Census Gazetteer internal points, not downtown coordinates or boundaries. Matching Natural Earth city labels are replaced while retaining their display rank. Airports include large and medium facilities plus small airports with four-letter identifiers; closed airports and heliports are omitted. Airport points are references, not evidence of airport use.
